title: Glove box access and radar-detector outlet placement
summary: Feedback centers on the glove box’s button-operated access and lock behavior, plus mentions of radar-detector power needs tied to the glove box outlet location.

positive.summary: The only positive feedback praises the glove box button design.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the glove box being hard to find or operate, preference for a traditional latch, inability to open or close it, and a nonfunctioning internal sensor.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention how the glove box locks in valet mode, questions about locking it, missing auxiliary storage, and radar-detector power routed through the glove-box-area outlet, but the examples are not sufficient to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: This topic mixes two loosely related subjects: glove box usability and locking, and radar-detector or 12V outlet placement.
Several example fragments are incomplete or purely informational, which limits confidence in interpreting user sentiment beyond the assigned labels.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 feedback.
